LAYOUT: All four panels are present and correctly placed: top-left (causal chain), top-right (recorded series), bottom-left (bit-pattern strip), and bottom-right (state card).
SERIES: The line plot shows four series (w, delta w, gradient, loss) in the legend. However, no data lines or points are visible in the plotting area; only a flat orange horizontal line is drawn near y=0.1. The purple "animated marker" is not visible. The trend is effectively flat/empty.
TEXT: Step 1 / 1; w = -1.7972145080566406; loss = 3.97563171336871875; FPS readout = 16 FPS drawn | step rate 100/s (top-right) and 53 FPS drawn (bottom-right); bits changed = 12 of 32.
BITS: 32 bit squares are drawn. The orange squares (changed) correspond to the pattern for `0xBFE60B20` (bits 1, 8-14, 17-19, 22, 25-27, 30-31). Hex word: 0xBFE60B20.
DEFECTS: The causal chain title says "(active phase: none)" instead of highlighting the "UPDATE" box in orange as requested. The recorded series panel is missing all data series lines and the purple marker despite being at step 1. There is minor text overlap between the bit-strip labels and the state card header.
VERDICT: FAIL (Missing data series in the live plot and incorrect active phase highlighting in the causal chain diagram).
